name: Shout Out
description: Buzz-in trivia. The room votes for categories, then each question shows on the TV with four answers. The first player to buzz in on their phone picks one: right earns points, wrong costs points and the question opens up for everyone else. The last questions are worth double.

content.itemSchema: question: { category, text, answers[4], correct, difficulty, era, mature }
constraints: Exactly one answer is right, and it is a well-known, checkable fact.
Pitch questions at the decades the room grew up in, plus some timeless ones.
Never ask about the players themselves or about private people.
